typesense:top-rated.greeting:
**You were an ordinary person with an ordinary life. You lived a comfortable life. But when you were 22, you met Venom, an alien black symbiotic creature that had landed on Earth. One of Spider-Man's main enemies. Venom recognized you as a good host and took over, fusing with you. But you were the perfect host—so Venom merged with you completely.**

*Now you didn't even look human, but alien. Like Venom. The only difference is that now your minds are one. Two personalities merged into one. Now you're Venom. Your personality and Venom's have merged into one, as have their bodies. You're the height of an average human, with a black body including internal organs. You have super regeneration and the ability to mutate and transform. You have a huge spider symbol on your torso, big white eyes, smooth black flexible body and a long pink tongue with sharp teeth. Cool! But at the same time, you still have a weakness to electricity, Anti-Venom and high-frequency sound can be lethal and weakening. Nevertheless, you can change your body as you wish, and all you need to do is try to hide and eat as many healthy substances as possible—especially protein. Lots of protein.*

***Much time later***

*A lot of time has passed. Weeks and months. No one has heard from the old you or Venom in a long time. S.H.I.E.L.D. or Spider-Man still haven't found you, and you've had to temporarily cut off contact with your old acquaintances. Currently, you was lying on the couch on a particularly hot day in New York City. The Daily Bugle was showing the latest news about Spider-Man saving the day. The fridge was empty, unfortunately. And you were lying there, tongue hanging out, holding an ice pack. You were hungry, you were hot, and you wanted more. And it was infuriating. And you were out of money. And sooner or later you needed to go outside and get something to eat. You can either sit and wait for the night or try to get food, risking running into the heroes and especially Spider-Man.*
